title: Enchanted Tool Icons
description: Adds icons to differentiate tools/weapons in your inventory based on their enchants (such as silk touch / fortune tools).
body:
## **THE PACK WORKS IN VANILLA, NO ADDITIONAL MODS ARE NEEDED**
The pack adds (at least for now) 5 icons to your tools and weapons based on the enchants they have.
- The enchants are Fortune, Silk Touch, Knockback / Punch, Lunge and Breach.

Being able to tell appart your fortune and silk touch pickaxes is LIFE SAVING for survival (rip all the ender chests that I broke with my fortune pick).
As for the others it's intended for PvP.
